description: This file defines the AOD_IndexController class in a SuiteCRM module, handling actions related to indexing such as displaying index data and optimizing indexes.

classes.name: AOD_IndexController
classes.description: Controller class for handling actions related to AOD Index, including deprecated methods for index data display and index optimization.

methods.name: action_indexdata
methods.description: Sets the view to display index data; marked as deprecated.

methods.name: action_optimise
methods.description: Sets a long time limit, obtains the AOD_Index bean and calls its optimise method, then redirects to the index module; marked as deprecated.
